company_profile: Redcare Pharmacy is a European online pharmacy selling prescription and over-the-counter medicines and health products to consumers across several countries.
title: Senior ML Engineer
summary: Machine learning engineer with 8+ years building and operating production ML systems across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Covers the full ML lifecycle, from problem framing and SQL and PySpark feature pipelines to training, evaluation, deployment with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow, and monitoring. Has built ranking and propensity models and explains trade-offs clearly to product and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Sponsored Product Ranking Model
bullets: Built a sponsored product ranking model for online retail search, blending organic relevance with advertiser bids using LightGBM learning-to-rank on PySpark-engineered click and purchase features.
Evaluated offline with time-based splits to avoid leakage, checked for position bias and distribution shift, and served ranking through FastAPI with MLflow-tracked models.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior ML Engineer role on the Retail Media team. I have spent 8+ years building ML systems that run in production, including ranking and propensity models that decide what a customer sees. The thread through my work is taking an unclear product question and making it a reliable system.

A retail media product built from the ground up inside a large online pharmacy is a rare chance to shape the models and the standards at once. Relevant ads for health products need extra care, which I like. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to build our life in Germany together and settle there long term.

At Optum I added a reranker to a plan recommendation system that increased conversion by 2%, and at Viavi I deployed a LightGBM SLA breach model with FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%. Retail media is new to me, but ranking, targeting and honest offline evaluation are not.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that a model is only useful when it serves the person on the other side. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
